payload.comment: Model search stage is internally consistent and properly executed. All 4 planned trials completed with 0 failures across 2 rounds. Selection rule (accuracy within 0.005 tolerance, then macro-F1) was correctly applied: res_cnn_wider_deep (val_acc=0.982707) is the sole candidate within tolerance of the best, and it also has the highest macro-F1 (0.982735). Test metrics were not used (test_locked=true, test_metrics_used=false). Config hashes are consistent between the selected candidate and the search report. The final train_config appropriately scales epochs from 2 (search) to 15 (final) and early_stopping_patience from 1 to 3, which is a sensible adaptation for the longer training run. All schema versions are 1.0. Source attribution (qwen3.8) is consistent across trials and the final selection. Validation metrics in best_configuration, search_report, and the individual trial record all agree. No deterministic findings were raised. Minor cosmetic note: several rationale strings are truncated with '…', which does not affect correctness. Ready to proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: Rationale strings in multiple artefacts are truncated (end with '…'), which limits full auditability of the design justification but does not affect numerical correctness or selection validity.

early_stopping_patience was changed from 1 (search trials) to 3 (final train_config) without an explicit note in the rationale; the change is reasonable for 15 epochs but is not explicitly justified in the provided text.
